records.title: Chemical standardization of kava (Piper methysticum) extract using UHPLC-MS/MS and the method of standard addition.
records.source_title: Chemical standardization of kava (Piper methysticum) extract using UHPLC-MS/MS and the method of standard addition.
records.abstract: This primary analytical investigation compared external calibration with standard addition for quantitative kava constituent assays. The authors reported matrix-induced ion suppression for desmethoxyyangonin and signal enhancement for dihydrokavain and flavokavain A. These results concern analytical method reliability rather than human efficacy or safety.
records.relevance_reason: Primary botanical chemical assay standardization informs product identity and research reproducibility.
records.uncertainty: Analytical method results do not establish human effects.
records.adverse_effects: Not evaluated in this laboratory method study.
records.interactions: Not evaluated in this laboratory method study.
records.limitations: Single botanical extract and instrument-specific matrix effects.
